scope: Concise scientific decisions with complete results indexed separately. Pilot selection evidence is not independent confirmation.
rules: Register a new scientific question or an explicit reason before repeating a completed cell.
A repeat needs a referenced prior ID and a concrete change, correction, unfinished cell, or prespecified independent confirmation.
Preserve failed and partial experiments plus historical source receipts. Do not silently replace an earlier conclusion.
Each new substantive experiment records exact method/data/source/config/seed/resource bindings in its native receipt and concise outcome here.
Native author execution, mathematical adaptations, published-task reproduction and common-data comparisons remain distinct.

decisions.hypothesis: Initial ordered lineage networks improve the easy oracle panel
decisions.method: Initial graph/set/GRU/Transformer/supra/lineage variants, two seeds, 16 TRAIN/4 VAL/8 historical pilot TEST parents.
decisions.conclusion: The nearest-TMRCA oracle comparator reached 98.10% grid accuracy. Initial neural models were much weaker. This panel does not support an ancestry improvement claim.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not rerun unchanged. Reopen only for a corrected encoder or a demonstrably harder inferred-tree task.

decisions.hypothesis: Reference reachability explains weak initial graph encoders
decisions.method: Reference-feature and genealogy-aware encoders on ancient oracle and paired inferred Q8 panels.
decisions.conclusion: Reference-aware controls improved the engineering comparison. Ordered-lineage novelty and superiority remain unsupported.
decisions.repeat_policy: Revisit only for a concrete input-reachability defect or new biological benchmark.

decisions.hypothesis: Boundary memory beats all-record temporal controls
decisions.method: Boundary full/diagonal/gain controls and GNN+GRU/Transformer, Q64 inferred pilot.
decisions.conclusion: Boundary full NLL 1.038652 versus GRU 1.038243. It did not consistently beat temporal controls on reused validation parents.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not repeat the same seed/config/cohort. A new model mechanism or independent biological confirmation needs a new entry.

decisions.hypothesis: Fixed-anchor cross-query geometry helps compared with diagonal decay
decisions.method: Nine plain anchor variants on 16 TRAIN/4 reused VAL Q64 inferred parents, seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Full depth2 NLL 1.025647 versus scalar 1.038708, diagonal 1.039765 and gain-matched diagonal 1.040722. These are exploratory selected scores.
decisions.repeat_policy: Independent parents/seeds and full-information competitors can confirm or reject this observation. No unchanged pilot rerun.

decisions.hypothesis: Query-source feedback explains the fixed-anchor result
decisions.method: Capacity-matched noncontextual/static controls, same Q64 parents/seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Full depth2 NLL 1.025647 and noncontextual depth2 1.026034 are nearly equal. Static depth2 NLL 1.117582 supports a sequence-information benefit in this pilot.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not assert a feedback contribution. Reopen only with a specific changed feedback mechanism or independent prespecified confirmation.

decisions.hypothesis: Age-conditioned graph geometry improves ancestry prediction
decisions.method: Full age versus matched scalar-age, depth1/2, same reused Q64 validation parents/seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Age full depth2 NLL 1.023317 versus scalar-age full depth2 1.025001. The difference is small and unconfirmed. Geometry audits alone are not prediction evidence.
decisions.repeat_policy: Independent biological evaluation can test this. Remaining scalar-age ablations are distinct unfinished cells, not reruns.

decisions.hypothesis: Anchor kernel improves over matched temporal layers
decisions.method: Same source encoder/anchors, GRU/Transformer and reference smoothing, Q64 seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Age full depth2 accuracy 53.7170% versus matched anchor GRU 53.0029% and Transformer 52.1454%. Scopes differ because the candidate propagates intervening geometry holds.
decisions.repeat_policy: Confirm with all-record competitors, independent parents and a frozen biological task. Shared data alone does not equal shared information access.

decisions.hypothesis: Paper-equation ARGMix adaptation matches the candidate pilot
decisions.method: Our independent full-tree/nearest-reference equation adaptations and whole-tree Transformer, same Q64 cohort.
decisions.conclusion: Full-tree ARGMix equation adaptation NLL1.142297/accuracy48.5321%, nearest-reference adaptation1.141211/48.4802%, whole-tree Transformer1.118489/50.3815%. These are our shared-data implementations and selected pilot scores, not native published benchmark reproductions.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not rerun these unchanged completed cells. Native author execution and independent frozen biological comparisons answer distinct questions.

decisions.hypothesis: GST and GraphSSM explain the Q64 pilot gain
decisions.method: GST cross-attention/span and GraphSSM ZOH on the same Q64 inferred parents/seed101.
decisions.conclusion: GST selected NLL 1.123058, accuracy 49.9237%. GraphSSM is still running. The older Q8 GST 63.60% result is a different task and cannot be compared numerically to Q64.
decisions.repeat_policy: Finish GraphSSM. Reopen only for independent confirmation, an audited implementation correction or a new frozen benchmark.

decisions.hypothesis: The kernel shows a broad cross-domain predictive advantage
decisions.method: Chickenpox fixed county topology, chronological validation, seed101. Ordinary controls and direct anchor/boundary adaptations.
decisions.conclusion: Ordinary GRU MAE 16.28198 is lower than anchor full depth1 16.83561/depth2 17.24698 and boundary full 18.01937. Current evidence does not support broad superiority. Remaining controls are still running.
decisions.repeat_policy: Complete pending cells. Do not repeat this unchanged pilot or claim a changing-topology result from fixed county data.

decisions.hypothesis: Ordered propagation responds to order and ignores identical subdivision
decisions.method: Untrained synthetic operator-order/subdivision probe, separate from ancestry training.
decisions.conclusion: The synthetic probe changes under reversal and retains subdivision differences at or below 4.1e-14. This establishes the measured structural behavior only.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not redo unchanged. Rerun if the operator implementation changes or to validate a new operator.

decisions.hypothesis: Native ARGMix reproduces published biological performance
decisions.method: Pinned unchanged author source c2481248eb0d, native TmrcaAttn component/TorchScript qualification.
decisions.conclusion: Nine CPU native component tests passed. No April-compatible revision was found in the inspected public resources, and the user has no older archive. Use unchanged c248 current-release transformer+GRU, with recorded differences. Native biological training remains pending.
decisions.repeat_policy: Build and execute the available native release on matched biological data. Do not call it April reproduction or repeat the same archive search without a new lead.

decisions.hypothesis: Native ARGformer is a genuine ancestry competitor
decisions.method: Pinned f7545be7bca0 node-vocabulary model, observed-only path/namespace/retrieval bridge.
decisions.conclusion: The exact author lock failed dependency/API checks. Evidence-directed packaging repairs retained Torch2.4 and unchanged source, and official FA2.6.3 installed with pip check passing. Actual full12-layer encoder/backward and biological pretraining/retrieval remain pending.
decisions.repeat_policy: Run native full-model MLM and contrastive qualification once on the reserved GPU. Repeat only after a specific observed failure is repaired. Then train on the frozen biological inputs with query ancestry targets sealed.

decisions.hypothesis: Native AncestralPaths supplies biological path ancestry and a comparator
decisions.method: All17 original files match the paper-cited Zenodo version, native5x9 features/six classes plus explicit probability collapse.
decisions.conclusion: The isolated runtime passed an actual six-class TensorFlow forward, one synthetic optimizer update and exact checkpoint replay. This uses a transparent adapter for the source-native Dense model. Biological training/scoring has not run. The source paper describes a differing CNN.
decisions.repeat_policy: Proceed to the frozen biological data contract. Repeat runtime checks only after relevant dependency/adapter changes. Preserve six-class output and explicit source collapse.

decisions.hypothesis: Fresh engineering development eliminates repeated-pilot selection
decisions.method: Frozen 64 TRAIN/16 VAL/TEST0 AncientEurope_4A21, Q64/24-reference cohort and deterministic runners.
decisions.conclusion: All80 oracle parents are prepared. Relate inferred-parent preparation is still running. The cohort is an engineering benchmark, not any supplied paper's numerical reproduction. No fresh fitting or final selection has completed.
decisions.repeat_policy: Complete the existing frozen preparation without editing pinned sources. A biological benchmark amendment is required before final confirmation.

decisions.hypothesis: Deterministic CUDA execution is admitted on the project stack
decisions.method: Synthetic admission v2 on actual physical GPU3, neural gradients/replay and deterministic smoothers.
decisions.conclusion: All44 synthetic CUDA cases passed. Initial UUID-prefix admission rejection is retained. These checks do not establish ancestry accuracy or completed fresh training.
decisions.repeat_policy: Repeat only if the admitted dependency/model/runtime changes. Do not use CPU/mock CUDA receipts as actual GPU evidence.

decisions.hypothesis: Sealed confirmation workflow protects independent evaluation
decisions.method: Fresh-context audit and repaired lock/prediction/custodian/temperature/joined analysis modules.
decisions.conclusion: Audits exposed and repaired provenance/publication/tile-edge defects. Final CPU suites and independent probes passed. No real selection/calibration/ID confirmation or genuine competitor adequacy was certified.
decisions.repeat_policy: Repeat targeted checks only after relevant code changes. Revise the biological task/comparator contract before any final lock or held-out access.

decisions.hypothesis: Real-data patterns support a new biological conclusion
decisions.method: Public phased/dated ancient and modern cohort, inferred trees, fixed ancestry and hypothesis contract.
decisions.conclusion: No real-data biological hypothesis has been tested here. Real-data agreement cannot establish per-site accuracy without ground truth.
decisions.repeat_policy: Prespecify a falsifiable hypothesis and public-data provenance first. Report concordance/robustness with uncertainty rather than known ancestry accuracy.

decisions.hypothesis: A learned low-rank whole-tree interface supplies a novel scalable kernel
decisions.method: Analytic proposal P row-stochastic, B=P diag(P^T1)^(-1/2), grounded generator (lambda+delta)I-lambda B_Q B_Q^T, exact rank-r actions and prior-art comparison.
decisions.conclusion: The unconstrained operator is standard normalized bipartite diffusion and a learned-star Kron response, with close hypergraph/DiffPool precedents. Positivity/contraction and rank-r actions are derivable, but Q64 speed, predictive benefit and distinct novelty are untested. No implementation or training ran.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not implement/retest the bare operator as novel. Reopen only for a precise observed age/path/shared-ancestor constraint with a justified scientific hypothesis and a new comparison against the standard operator.

decisions.hypothesis: Native competitors and the candidate improve source/path ancestry on a matched biological panel
decisions.method: Four new2Mb development parents,2TRAIN/2VAL/TEST0, proposed140 diploids with96 pure reference haplotypes,64 mixed-reference haplotypes and120 queries. Source-derived11-population demographic model, six path classes plus explicit C4 collapse.
decisions.conclusion: The biological panel and full-span score contract are proposed. Actual simulations, Relate inferred observations and native fits remain pending. The140-diploid panel is distinct from the authors'476 diagnostic cohort. No final holdout count or performance claim is frozen.
decisions.repeat_policy: Review/freeze executable demographic/sample/seed details, then run these new development parents and source-default methods. Existing Q64 engineering scores cannot answer this task. Power final comparison from development variation before any final outcomes.
